name: stocksharp-odysseus
description: Generate, compile, validate and backtest StockSharp trading strategies locally.
long_description: Requires the .NET 10 SDK on PATH. Includes the matching worker and runner. Projects and historical data stay in the folders selected during installation. Broker connections require separate operator configuration. Product installation is disabled unless the operator explicitly allows products.

projects_root.title: Projects folder
projects_root.description: Workspace folder for project JSON files and research artifacts. Use one MCP process per workspace.

market_data.description: Folder for shared historical market data.
